verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair thing to ask of a payments API platform, but the evidence pack never documents a Mangopay command-line tool. The SDKs (Node.js, PHP, Python, .NET, Java, Ruby), the OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and the MCP server are related developer tools, not a CLI, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
